copy.headline: Get holly jolly at these 2026 holiday pop-up bars around Fort Worth
copy.caption: Even the grouchiest grinch will find Christmas cheer with a visit to one of these Fort Worth-area holiday pop-up bars, which return this year with even more tinsel.

story.title: Get holly jolly at these 2026 holiday pop-up bars around Fort Worth
story.summary: Even the grouchiest grinch will find Christmas cheer with a visit to one of these Fort Worth-area holiday pop-up bars, which return this year with even more tinsel, twinkling lights, gilded glassware, and the festive sips.
